title: Compact metrics cards & rollout controls — design library expansion
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem statement: Current Console has multiple metric card designs (dense, expanded, snapshot) and a separate rollout control rail. Product and Eng have requested a consolidated, compact card component and a paired rollout-controls pattern to improve information density on high-traffic dashboards and reduce layout duplication across cost and SLO views. Goal: create a single, token-driven compact metrics card and a small-surface rollout control component that are reusable across dashboards, cost insights, and the rollout UI. Must be themeable via semantic tokens and meet WCAG AA color contrast. Deliver a Figma component set, migration guidelines, and a short dev handoff with code-ready specs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library includes CompactMetricCard component with 3 variants: Snapshot, Sparkline, and InlineActions
Token mapping doc that translates component tokens to runtime semantic tokens (bg, fg, accent, subtle) and spacing scale
RolloutControls component (compact toggle + status pill + rollback link) with accessible keyboard flow and aria labels
Performance: recommended CPU/DOM footprint notes for frontend engineers (max 3 elements per card for fastest reflow)
Design review approvals from PM (Ravi Patel) and Eng owners (Liam O'Connor) recorded in comments
Migration checklist for 6 existing dashboard screens with estimated effort per screen
deliverables: Figma file: Console > Components > Metrics > CompactMetricCard (https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/console-components-compact)
Design tokens CSV: compact-metrics-tokens.csv attached to PRD
Handoff package: storybook-ready spec + accessibility checklist

notes: Trade-offs discussed: we intentionally keep CompactMetricCard minimal to avoid coupling to eval/chart libs. If teams need heavier interactions (drill-in), use the ExpandedCard variant in the library. Will iterate on token names to align with runtime semantic tokens in the next Token Convergence epic.
